public_holidays: 26 May 2026: non-working holiday in the city of Tacna, provincial scope, for Alto de la Alianza (Law 24681). 28 August: civic non-working day for reincorporation (Law 23849). 14 September: non-working day for Señor de Locumba (Regional Ordinance 013-2015).

culture-cycles.note: Read directly: these are the official calendar's past 2026 listings, not a claim of 2027 recurrence or uniform closure of tourist services.
